diagnosis: The OpenSearch log search endpoint accepts free-text search queries from authenticated cloud customers. However, the Elasticsearch query does not enforce a bool.filter containing term: { customer_id: req.user.customerId }, causing OpenSearch to scan all customer indexes and returning proprietary server access logs, tokens, and infrastructure events of other tenants.
exploit_request:
GET /api/infra/logs/search?query=api_key+OR+password HTTP/1.1
Host: logs.cloudplatform.com
Authorization: Bearer <customer_token>
